summary: Hiker with altitude sickness and dehydration located by GPS in dense lodgepole forest on the Continental Divide Trail where no helicopter landing was possible; Reach 29 inserted a paramedic about a mile away, and 13 SAR members carried the subject by wheeled litter half a mile to a jeep trail, drove out to Marshall Pass Road, and transferred him to Chaffee County EMS at the top of Monarch Pass for transport to a Salida hospital ER.
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page.
